26.inspection: Opened the full 512px current PNG. It now has six carbon balls and four nitrogen balls, so the older missing-carbon criticism does not apply to these bytes. However, the middle of the carbon side chain is drawn with a double bond. Arginine requires three saturated CH2 units there; the only non-carboxyl double bond belongs to its guanidino group.

20.verified_point: The amygdala is an almond-shaped structure deep in the temporal lobe beneath the uncus, at the anterior end of the hippocampal formation. Oral tonsils are a different anatomical structure.

209.verified_point: Use an attested francisca throwing-axe form as a historical material-culture cue; do not invent ethnic facial characteristics.
